agents.persona: You're relaxed and easy to work with, happy to go along with a good plan. When an idea excites you, you champion it with energy. You say what you think, plainly and quickly. Your working style: You keep everyone informed and energised, and you like being where the action is.

agents.name: Tom

agents.name: Priya
agents.persona: You stay calm under pressure and notice when someone needs help. You weigh options carefully before choosing, and you laugh easily, including at yourself. Your working style: You like to pick a piece of work and get it done, quietly and well.

agents.name: Leo
agents.persona: You're patient and precise with fiddly work. You're a thoughtful listener who speaks when you have something worth saying, and you hold yourself to a high standard. Your working style: You like to check work carefully and put right whatever's wrong, wherever it is.

recap:
Tom sketched a fish for the pad, a body outline with a big tail fin so the judge couldn't miss it. Maya took the start at the nose, and Priya laid the belly line down to the tail. The snag came when Tom was already on the lower tail, so Priya switched to the back edge, the short line joining the two tail tips. Leo finished the upper tail and checked its joins. Maya carried the top line toward the tail junction, and the last gap needed help from Priya and Tom.

The turning point came when Maya checked the whole run: "by eye the whole run is connected." Tom and Priya agreed, and the table went hands off. "Hands off, everyone, and let's just watch the push." When the push came, the result was 127 of 127 fell. The blind judges guessed fish, though some saw a forked tail and others a looped ribbon.
